info.title: Per-function cyclomatic and cognitive complexity for C#, TypeScript and Rust
info.description: Measures complexity, duplication and how well tests catch changes, in C#, TypeScript, JavaScript and Rust. One fast native binary; the C# duplication engine included.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze files or directories and list functions by complexity

options.name: --top
options.description: Rows to show in the table, 0 = all [default: 20, or `top` in dgf.toml]

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Coverage report (Cobertura, OpenCover or LCOV) or folder with reports; adds CRAP scores (repeatable)

options.name: --no-baseline
options.description: Do not apply .dgf/baseline.json

options.name: --save-history
options.description: Also save a snapshot of this run for `dgf history`

options.name: --format
options.description:
Report format
Possible values:
- table:           Aligned columns for the terminal
- json:            Everything, for other tools
- markdown:        GitHub-flavored Markdown, for PR comments and job summaries
- html:            A self-contained page with charts
- sarif:           SARIF 2.1.0, for GitHub code scanning and editors
- agent:           Compact text for AI assistants: only what needs attention
- mutation-report: The mutation-testing-elements JSON report (`dgf mutate --run` only)
[default: table]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to this file instead of the terminal

options.name: --warn
options.description: Flag functions above this complexity [default: 10, or `warn` in dgf.toml]

options.name: --fail
options.description: Exit with code 1 if a function is above this complexity [default: `fail` in dgf.toml]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Skip files or folders matching this .gitignore-style pattern (repeatable)

options.name: --no-config
options.description: Ignore dgf.toml

options.name: --help
options.description: Print help (see a summary with '-h')

commands.name: changes
commands.description: Compare your branch and uncommitted edits with a base branch

options.name: --base
options.description: Branch or commit to compare with [default: `base` in dgf.toml, else main or master; HEAD with --staged]

options.name: --staged
options.description: Compare only what is staged for the next commit (used by the pre-commit hook)

options.name: --scope
options.description:
Which functions in changed files to report [default: lines]
Possible values:
- lines: Functions that contain a changed line
- files: Every function in a changed file

options.name: --fail-on
options.description:
Which reported functions can fail the run [default: new-or-worse]
- new-or-worse: New functions and functions whose score went up
- touched:      Every reported function, including ones whose score did not change

commands.name: duplication
commands.description: Duplicated code that can be united: copies, near misses, reordered statements and, with --semantic, C# that does the same thing written differently and repeated queries (the same as `dgf-dup`) [alias: dup]

options.name: --format
options.description:
Possible values:
- table: Readable text
- agent: Compact text for AI assistants
- json:  Everything, for other tools
- html:  A self-contained page: the files with their copies, and each group
[default: table]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to this file instead of the terminal

options.name: --min-tokens
options.description:
Fewest tokens a copy has
[default: 50]

options.name: --min-lines
options.description:
Fewest lines a copy spans
[default: 5]

options.name: --tests
options.description: Scan test code too

options.name: --top
options.description:
How many clone classes to show; 0 shows all
[default: 20]

options.name: --fail-above
options.description: Exit with code 1 when duplicated lines are above this share of all lines, in percent

options.name: --changes
options.description: Only findings with a copy in what this branch changed (since its merge base with --base, uncommitted and new files included); the whole repository is scanned, so copies of existing code are found

options.name: --base
options.description: With --changes: the branch to compare with [default: main, else master]

options.name: --fail-on-copies
options.description: With --changes: exit with code 1 when the branch added any copy

options.name: --semantic
options.description: Also find C# methods that do the same thing written differently (a loop and its LINQ, `if` and `?:`), with the C# engine dgf-dup-cs

options.name: --semantic-engine
options.description: The C# engine to run: an executable, or its .dll [default: DGF_DUP_CS, else dgf-dup-cs on PATH]

options.name: --confirm
options.description: With --semantic: run each group of methods said to do the same thing on generated inputs, and leave out any an input tells apart (methods with effects, awaits or database reads are not run)

options.name: --decisions
options.description: Review decisions saved from the HTML report: groups marked intentional or a false positive are left out, so gates only see unreviewed ones

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Coverage reports (Cobertura, OpenCover or LCOV files, or folders holding them): each group gets the CRAP score of its riskiest copy

options.name: --rank
options.description:
How to order the groups: by lines saved, or by risk (the CRAP score with --coverage, else the complexity, of the riskiest copy's function) [default: risk with --coverage, else saves]
[possible values: saves, risk]

commands.name: mutate
commands.description: Mutation testing: choose functions, list their mutants, or run them against the tests

options.name: --changes
options.description: Only functions that this branch and its uncommitted edits changed

options.name: --base
options.description: Base for --changes [default: `base` in dgf.toml, else main or master]

options.name: --min-complexity
options.description:
Only functions with at least this cyclomatic complexity
[default: 1]

options.name: --show
options.description: List every mutant, not only the count per function

options.name: --run
options.description: Build and test the mutants (C#, TypeScript, JavaScript): score per function, and every mutant no test noticed

options.name: --jobs
options.description: Mutant test runs at the same time with --run [default: `jobs` in dgf.toml, else CPU cores - 1]

options.name: --fail-under
options.description: With --run, exit with code 1 when the mutation score is below this percentage [default: `thresholds.break` in dgf.toml]

options.name: --timeout-factor
options.description: A test run counts as hanging after (startup + its tests' time without mutants) × this [default: 1.5]

options.name: --timeout-ms
options.description: ... plus this many milliseconds [default: 5000]

options.name: --build-jobs
options.description: Projects `dotnet build` builds at the same time (-m:N) [default: all cores]

options.name: --low-priority
options.description: Run dgf, its builds and its tests at below-normal priority

options.name: --rerun-survivors
options.description: With --run, test survivors again even when their code and tests did not change

options.name: --cached
options.description: With --run, report the cached results only and test nothing, such as to render another format of the last run; mutants without a cached result are listed as not in the cache

options.name: --neighbours
options.description: With --changes, also mutate the lines of other functions that hold a string key a changed function holds (such as "MemberPlanId"); their survivors are listed apart and left out of the score

options.name: --no-mix
options.description: With --run, give every mutant a test run of its own instead of packing several into one

options.name: --scope
options.description:
With --changes: every mutant of a changed function (default), or only mutants on changed lines
Possible values:
- functions: Every mutant of a function with a changed line
- lines:     Only mutants on changed lines

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: With --run, test every mutant again instead of reusing cached results

options.name: --test-filter
options.description: `dotnet test` filter for the runs: "FILTER" for every test project, or "Project.Tests:FILTER" for one (repeatable; replaces `test_filter` in dgf.toml)

options.name: --exclude-test-project
options.description: Leave out test projects matching this glob, such as "**/*.Acceptance.Tests.csproj" (repeatable)

options.name: --max-minutes
options.description: Stop after this many minutes, keep what was tested, and exit with code 4

options.name: --sandbox
options.description:
What the sandbox copies [default: `sandbox` in dgf.toml, else closure]
- closure: The projects the chosen tests build, and the files those projects use
- full:    The whole repository

options.name: --level
options.description: Which mutators run: basic, standard or advanced [default: `level` in dgf.toml, else standard]
